# meshes.library: SameFaceKey

```plato

    // True when two faces have the same corner set.
    SameFaceKey(a: TriangleFace, b: TriangleFace): Boolean {
        var x = SortedFaceKey(a);
        var y = SortedFaceKey(b);
        return x.X == y.X && x.Y == y.Y && x.Z == y.Z;
    }

    // Every face of every cell, four per tetrahedron, in cell order.
    CandidateFaces(self: TetrahedralMesh3D): Array<TriangleFace>
        => (self.Cells.Count * 4).MapRange(i => TetrahedronFace(self.Cells[i / 4], i % 4));

    // The boundary surface: the positions unchanged, and the faces that no
    // second cell shares.
    ToTriangleMesh(self: TetrahedralMesh3D): TriangleMesh3D {
        var candidates = self.CandidateFaces;
        var empty = candidates.Take(0);
        var boundary = candidates.FlatMap(face =>
            candidates.Reduce(0, (acc, other) => SameFaceKey(face, other) ? acc + 1 : acc) == 1
                ? empty.Append(face)
                : empty);
        return (self.Positions, boundary);
    }
}
```
